guard: closed run replies bind the manager-held nkeys and reject partial or foreign-account pairs
command: pnpm --dir packages/core build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/manager/smoke/remote-run-client.smoke.ts

mutations.name: run response ignores request id
mutations.expectRed: request, registration, process and nkey mismatch refuse
mutations.cell: request, registration, process and nkey mismatch refuse

mutations.name: run response accepts a missing mediator
mutations.find: const credentials = exactKeys(result.credentials, attempt ? ["driver", "mediator"] : ["operator"], "manager run credentials");
mutations.replace: const credentials = exactKeys(result.credentials, attempt ? ["driver"] : ["operator"], "manager run credentials");
mutations.expectRed: first attempt supplies exactly the held pair
mutations.cell: first attempt supplies exactly the held pair

mutations.name: run response skips foreign-account validation
mutations.expectRed: a foreign signer with the right public nkey still refuses before adoption
mutations.cell: a foreign signer with the right public nkey still refuses before adoption
